searchText: <timbeiko> I'd lean towards more accurate 😁! A simple tweak may be to mention `MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS` in the EIP and point people to the CL spec (to avoid stale values)? my viewpoint is also EIPs shouldn't deal with real values and just use the names (constants or fns) which people can correlate with the referred specs
